title: IoT Controllers | HD20 Series / HR-10 | Hitelecom
metaDescription: Explore Hitelecom IoT controllers and RTUs: HD20-2000, HD20-4000 and HD20-1000 series plus the HR-10 controller & DTU. Field I/O, edge processing, Modbus and 4G LTE with Hitelecom Cloud monitoring.

categoryDescriptions.257: Select the controller series for the installation signal list: HD20-2000, HD20-4000 and HD20-1000 field I/O controllers, or the HR-10 compact controller & DTU.

heroValue:
Field observations.
Connected to your operation.
heroImageNote: Product arrangements shown for reference; supplied sensors, power and mounting follow the project configuration.
catalogIntro: Start with the measurements needed at each site, then confirm the sensor set, installation, power and communication configuration.
sharedConfigNote: Each station is configured with 2–12 sensor channels. IP65 is the published station protection reference; sensing assemblies, power and communication are selected per project.
